modules.title: Introduction to Case Study Analysis
modules.description: This module introduces the concept of case study analysis and its importance in various fields.

sub_modules.title: Understanding Case Studies
sub_modules.description: In this sub-module, students will learn about different types of case studies, their applications, and the key characteristics that make them effective.

activities.title: Understanding Case Studies Quiz
activities.description: This quiz assesses students' understanding of case studies and their applications.

activities.title: Case Study Analysis Basics
activities.description: In this activity, students will learn the basics of case study analysis, including how to identify key elements and create a structured approach.

activities.title: Case Study Reading and Preparation
activities.description: This sub-module prepares students for the next module by having them read and analyze a sample case study.
learning_objectives: Understand how to critically evaluate a case study.
Learn how to identify key elements of a case study.

sub_modules.title: Analyzing and Interpreting Case Studies
sub_modules.description: This module teaches students how to analyze and interpret case studies, including identifying problems, gathering information, and developing solutions.

activities.title: Analyzing and Interpreting Case Studies Quiz
activities.description: This quiz assesses students' ability to analyze and interpret case studies.

activities.title: Case Study Analysis Framework
activities.description: In this activity, students will learn a framework for analyzing and interpreting case studies.

activities.title: Analyzing and Interpreting Case Studies (Practical Application)
activities.description: This sub-module has students work on real-world case study analysis problems.
learning_objectives: Understand how to apply the framework to analyze a case study.

sub_modules.title: Developing Solutions and Drawing Conclusions
sub_modules.description: This module teaches students how to develop solutions and draw conclusions from their analysis of case studies.

activities.title: Developing Solutions Quiz
activities.description: This quiz assesses students' ability to develop solutions based on their analysis of a case study.

activities.title: Case Study Solution Development
activities.description: In this activity, students will learn how to develop solutions and draw conclusions from their analysis of a case study.

activities.title: Developing Solutions and Drawing Conclusions (Practical Application)
activities.description: This sub-module has students work on real-world case study analysis problems.
learning_objectives: Understand how to apply the framework to develop solutions.

sub_modules.title: Final Project: Case Study Analysis
sub_modules.description: This module has students work on a final project where they will analyze and present a case study.

activities.title: Project Proposal
activities.description: In this activity, students will submit a proposal for their final project.

activities.title: Final Project (Case Study Analysis)
activities.description: This sub-module has students work on their final project.
learning_objectives: Understand how to apply the framework to analyze and present a case study.
